tailoring.headline: SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris) Developer | Java, Spring & OCC REST APIs | SAP Certified
tailoring.summary: Backend developer with 5+ years of professional experience building, extending and supporting large enterprise e-commerce platforms (SAP Commerce Cloud / Hybris 2105 and 2211) for Rockwell Automation and Shell. Strong in Java, Spring and Spring Boot, RESTful APIs, microservices, SQL and database performance tuning, with proven delivery of data and API integrations between PIM, ERP and MDM systems. SAP Certified Commerce Cloud Developer with hands-on experience in headless commerce and enterprise integrations.

APIs & Integration: PIM / ERP / MDM integration (Profisee, SAP ERP)

cover_en.subject: Application: SAP Commerce Cloud Developer
cover_en.hook: Bringing over 5 years of hands-on backend and enterprise e-commerce expertise built at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I am excited to apply my background in SAP Commerce Cloud development to support your digital platforms. My professional track record centers on engineering robust, scalable solutions and integrating complex data pipelines for global enterprise environments.

bullets.label: Enterprise Commerce Architecture
bullets.text: Designed and implemented backend functionality on SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris 2211) using Java and Spring, covering product, catalog, pricing, and customer data management following platform best practices.

bullets.label: Headless & OCC REST APIs
bullets.text: Developed and exposed OCC REST Web Services and headless APIs for storefront and third-party consumers, customizing Interceptors, Populators, and Converters for seamless custom data flows.

bullets.label: Complex Integrations & Data Pipelines
bullets.text: Engineered PIM-to-Hybris data pipelines using Profisee, Hotfolders, and DataHub to synchronize product catalogs across global e-commerce channels and resolve integration bottlenecks with ERP and MDM platforms.

bullets.label: Cloud Deployments & Performance
bullets.text: Executed CI/CD deployment cycles on SAP Commerce Cloud Portal (CCv2) and led database query refactoring that reduced response latency and improved transaction speed.

cover_en.logistics: I am based in Karlsruhe with a valid German residence and work permit. I am currently serving my notice period with a last working day of 15 December 2026, and I am available to start from 16 December 2026. I look forward to discussing how my enterprise commerce background can benefit your team.

tailoring.why_company: I am eager to contribute my 5+ years of enterprise e-commerce expertise to your team, bringing deep hands-on experience with SAP Commerce Cloud, Java, and complex system integrations. My background delivering scalable backend architecture for global brands like Rockwell Automation and Shell equips me to drive immediate impact on your digital platforms.
tailoring.motivation_short: Bringing 5+ years of SAP Commerce Cloud and Java enterprise expertise, I build robust e-commerce solutions, headless APIs, and seamless system integrations.
tailoring.linkedin_message: Hello, I am an SAP Certified Commerce Developer with 5+ years of experience building enterprise e-commerce platforms and OCC REST APIs at Rockwell Automation and Shell. I am exploring new opportunities in Germany starting December 2026 and would love to connect regarding your open roles.
tailoring.email_subject: Application for SAP Commerce Developer - Kranti Chavan
tailoring.email_body:
Dear Hiring Team,

Please find attached my CV and cover letter for your open e-commerce developer position. With over 5 years of professional experience building and extending enterprise platforms using SAP Commerce Cloud, Java, Spring, and OCC REST APIs at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I bring proven expertise in headless commerce and complex system integrations.

I am based in Karlsruhe with a valid work permit, serving notice until 15 December 2026 with an earliest start date of 16 December 2026. I look forward to discussing how I can add value to your team.

Best regards,
Kranti Chavan
